Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low
back pain and muscle tightness. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the
reported symptoms, and the presentation is entirely plausible for a collision of this
type. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of
motion, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient has a
remote history of a minor strain in the same region, which resolved completely without
lasting limitation and does not affect the current assessment. Over the course of
fourteen visits, treatment followed a standard conservative protocol including manual
therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Care tapered
grdaually as pain decreased and function improved, and the patient was discharged to
self-directed home exercise. Billing for the episode reflects one charge per scheduled
service with no repeated or duplicate entries.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
